integrity: Full symbolic proof and standalone exact-rational finite-state and extremal checks included; no claim of machine proof for unbounded parameters.
scientific_limitations: The model assumes a finite undirected tree, two seeds, permanent mutual exclusion, positive edge transmissions, and homogeneous rates on the path. The central branching extremum additionally assumes equal rates. This is a theoretical result and is not an empirical epidemic forecast; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Sharp variance extremizers for two competing irreversible infections on finite trees
